from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

# Reload reference mol with stereo tags
with open("mol2d.mol") as f:
    molblock = f.read()
m = Chem.MolFromMolBlock(molblock, sanitize=False, removeHs=False)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
mH = Chem.AddHs(m)

# Load optimized xyz into the mol
m2 = Chem.MolFromMolFile("opt.xyz", sanitize=False, removeHs=False) if False else None

# Parse opt.xyz manually and set conformer on a copy
conf = Chem.Conformer(mH.GetNumAtoms())
with open("opt.xyz") as f:
    lines = f.read().splitlines()
n = int(lines[0])
coords = [l.split() for l in lines[2:2+n]]
print("xyz atoms:", n, "mol atoms:", mH.GetNumAtoms())
elems_xyz = [c[0] for c in coords]
elems_mol = [mH.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol() for i in range(mH.GetNumAtoms())]
print("elements match:", elems_xyz == elems_mol)
for i,c in enumerate(coords):
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i, (float(c[1]), float(c[2]), float(c[3])))
mH2 = Chem.Mol(mH)
mH2.RemoveAllConformers()
mH2.AddConformer(conf)
# Reassign CIP from 3D
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mH2)
centers = Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mH2, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False)
print("CIP from optimized 3D:", centers)

# Check ethylidene E/Z: atoms u(16,0-based)=16, v=17, substituents w(19), x(18)
# dihedral w-u=v-x
def dihedral(p0,p1,p2,p3):
    b0 = -1.0*(p1-p0); b1 = p2-p1; b2 = p3-p2
    b1 /= np.linalg.norm(b1)
    v = b0 - np.dot(b0,b1)*b1
    w = b2 - np.dot(b2,b1)*b1
    x = np.dot(v,w); y = np.dot(np.cross(b1,v),w)
    return np.degrees(np.arctan2(y,x))

pos = np.array([[float(c[1]),float(c[2]),float(c[3])] for c in coords])
# w(0-based 19) - u(16) = v(17) - x(18)
d = dihedral(pos[19],pos[16],pos[17],pos[18])
print("dihedral w-u=v-x (ethylidene):", round(d,1), "deg ->", "E (trans high-priority)" if abs(d)>90 else "Z")

# Also check the cyclohexene A=B geometry: bh1(2)-A(10)=B(11)-Cd(14)
d2 = dihedral(pos[2],pos[10],pos[11],pos[14])
print("dihedral bh1-A=B-Cd:", round(d2,1), "deg (should be ~0 cis ring)")

# Key distances to confirm connectivity
def dist(i,j): return round(float(np.linalg.norm(pos[i]-pos[j])),3)
print("bh2(1)-N4(20):", dist(1,20))
print("bh1(2)-Me(9):", dist(2,9))
print("Cd(14)-H(23):", dist(14,23))
print("N4(20)-ethylCH2(21):", dist(20,21))
print("bh2(1)-N1(0):", dist(1,0))

import numpy as np

# Load optimized coords
with open("opt.xyz") as f:
    lines = f.read().splitlines()
n = int(lines[0])
elems = []
pos = []
for l in lines[2:2+n]:
    p = l.split()
    elems.append(p[0]); pos.append([float(p[1]),float(p[2]),float(p[3])])
pos = np.array(pos)

# Drawing 2D targets for heavy atoms (0-based idx): (x, -y_img)
draw = {
 0:(330,-445), 1:(413,-357), 2:(357,-252), 3:(240,-275), 4:(140,-205), 5:(15,-250),
 6:(10,-375), 7:(105,-440), 8:(227,-400), 9:(327,-136), 10:(416,-149), 11:(537,-150),
 12:(595,-44), 13:(675,-45), 14:(595,-240), 15:(538,-358), 16:(658,-356), 17:(770,-355),
 18:(815,-310), 19:(600,-460), 20:(477,-460), 21:(477,-280), 22:(408,-208)
}
idxs = sorted(draw.keys())
P = pos[idxs]                      # optimized (3D)
Q = np.array([draw[i] for i in idxs])  # drawing 2D (z=0)
Q3 = np.column_stack([Q, np.zeros(len(Q))])

# scale: match drawing units to angstroms
s = np.sqrt(((P-P.mean(0))**2).sum() / ((Q3-Q3.mean(0))**2).sum())
Q3s = Q3 * s

# Kabsch: rotate P onto Q3s
Pc = P - P.mean(0); Qc = Q3s - Q3s.mean(0)
H = Pc.T @ Qc
U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(H)
d = np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T @ U.T))
D = np.diag([1,1,d])
R = Vt.T @ D @ U.T
pos_rot = (pos - P.mean(0)) @ R.T
print("det(R)=", round(np.linalg.det(R),3))

# Write oriented xyz

    f.write(f"{n}\noriented to drawing view\n")
    for i in range(n):

# bh1-Me (9), bh2-N4 (20), Cd-H (23)
